title: Quality of Life (QOL) Registry for Patients With AL Amyloidosis
brief_summary: This is an online registry to document the psychometric properties of SF-36v2 among patients with AL Amyloidosis, to document patients' burden of disease, to better understand the patient's experience and to follow quality of life issues using a variety of QOL measures.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients must have AL Amyloidosis

Exclusion Criteria:
